newsitem.title: MEXICO: BOXING-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION GONZALEZ ARRESTED IN MEXICO.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION GONZALEZ ARRESTED IN MEXICO.

text.p: Alejandro "La Cobrita" Gonzalez Loera, a former World Boxing Council featherweight champion, has been arrested for illegal arms possession and making threats, police said Friday.
A police statement said Gonzalez, a 23-year-old Mexican, is accused of threatening the manager of a Guadalajara nightclub with a handgun.
In March last year, Gonzalez lost his world title to Filipino Luisito Espinoza.
The Guadalajara daily newspaper Siglo 21 reported that this was the fourth time Gonzalez has been arrested in the past two years.
